programs.candidate_requirement:
3rd – 4th year student or fresh graduate with less than 1 year of experience; open for all majors.
Bachelor's degree required and GPA (Grade Point Average): from 7.0 out of 10 or equivalent.
Language: Native Vietnamese speaker with fluent in English.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel) and ability to quickly adapt to new systems.
Be able to start working full-time from September 2026, and take 6-month duration.
Be bold to take risks, solves challenges in new ways and works hard to make a difference.
Be interested in a multi-functional career and have the willingness to develop new skillsets and capabilities throughout your career.
Desire to learn, evolve, and adapt and is innately curious.
Operates with a continuous learning mindset.
Shows confidence in ambiguous situations and thrives in a fast-paced environment.
Leverages insight, innovation and technology to stay ahead of the curve.
Takes pride, ownership and accountability for their actions.
Recognizes the impact we have to our customers, consumers, and communities.
Seeks diverse perspectives; co-creates win-win solutions across teams; recognizes contributions and celebrates successes.
Inclusive mindset; shows humility and empathy.

- Sinh viên năm cuối hoặc mới tốt nghiệp hoặc ứng viên có dưới 2 năm kinh nghiệm làm việc ở lĩnh vực liên quan
- Có thể làm việc fulltime kể từ tháng 9.2026
- Quan tâm và mong muốn phát triển sự nghiệp trong lĩnh vực Data hoặc Commercial
- Sẵn sàng học hỏi, chủ động đón nhận thử thách và tạo ra giá trị thực tế

- University graduates with a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in any discipline, with no more than 2 years of full-time work experience (as of application deadline)
- Curious and adaptable learners who tackle challenges with resourcefulness and agility
- Effective communicators who can share ideas and thoughts effectively
- Self-starters with a growth mindset who take ownership and aspire to drive meaningful impact
- Leaders who can inspire others towards the achievement of goals

Strong Academic Foundation
- GPA of 3.2/4.0 or 8.0/10 and above
- Proficiency in English: B2 level, IELTS 6.0, TOEIC 750, TOEFL iBT 79
- Fresh graduates or candidates with less than 2 years of full-time work experience, available to work full-time from August 2026
AI-First Mindset
- Passionate about technology with a curious drive to explore the latest digital tools and platforms
- Know how to leverage AI as a "co-pilot" at work - from data analysis and content creation to automating everyday workflows
Cultural Fit
- You’re proactive, adaptable, and genuinely excited about technology and fintech
- You’re ready to embrace MoMo’s mission and core values-and make a meaningful impact along the way
High Growth Potential
- You bring a growth mindset, adapt quickly, and show strong leadership potential
- You’re driven, committed for the long term, and ready to grow into future leadership roles

- Technology:
Final-year students from Vietnamese or overseas universities
Bachelor's degree and/or higher in IT, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.
Ability: Strong coding, software development and system design skills.
Able to solve technical problems with logic, creativity, and customer-centricity in mind.
Less than 2 years of full-time work experience
Proficiency in spoken and written English
- Data & AI: 
Final-year students from Vietnamese or overseas universities
Bachelor's degree and/or higher in AI Science, Statistics, Quantitative Science, Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics & other related fields.
Ability: Able to work with data tools (Python, SQL, Power BI). Strong statistical thinking with understanding of data visualization and data analysis.
Less than 2 years of full-time work experience
Proficiency in spoken and written English
- Business:
Final-year students from Vietnamese or overseas universities
Bachelor's degree and/or higher in Business Administration, Banking & Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Economics & other related fields.
Ability: Understands business operations, customer behavior and experiences. Strong in market and product analysis.
Less than 2 years of full-time work experience
Proficiency in spoken and written English
- General Management: 
Final-year students from Vietnamese or overseas universities
Bachelor's degree and/or higher in Business Administration, Banking & Finance, Human Resource & other related fields.
Ability: Learns quickly, connects dots, and drives execution across domains. Understand business operations, management and people.
Less than 2 years of full-time work experience
Proficiency in spoken and written English

- Candidates in their final year of university or graduated with cumulative scores equivalent to "Very good" degree in the fields of Logistics, E-commerce, Supply Chain, Foreign Economics, Import-Export, International Trade, Transport Exploitation, Customs and similar fields; or won national/international awards in related fields; or have excellent achievements when participating in major projects in related fields.

- English with a minimum score of 550 TOEIC or equivalent.

- Location: Hanoi (For candidates outside Hanoi area, round-trip airfare will be sponsored).
